video.agency.evidence: [影魔·codex] 图1第1行第7–8格（1.50–1.75秒）已出现黑柱，但我的双爪仍在身体两侧，未见对应的双臂举过头顶；第2行第2–4格（2.25–2.75秒）主要呈向两侧伸臂，无法确认每发都有独立的落臂、举顶施法。第5行第4–7格（8.75–9.50秒）我仍伸臂动作，不能确认已按规格6.9秒后的收势拍落回双手。仅凭这些格子，无法建立我主动锁定目标、连续九次出手的清楚行动链，判fail。；[树人·claude] Image 1 (4 fps sheet). From 0–1.25s the treants run toward him from the right, which is in character. After that, the behaviour I'd have as a treant doesn't hold up. At 3.25–3.75s one treant stands upright in the middle of the black column and doesn't fall straight away. In the 4.0s frame there is also a figure still standing under the smoke column. It isn't the 'freezes and falls on its back the instant the column rises' the spec asks for. At 5.0–6.5s the rear groups on the right stay in tight clumps with the same spacing as before. I can't see any treant pause, spread to the sides, crouch to sprint past, or go around the smoking bodies. That fails the survival-instinct part of the spec ('not lining up to die'), and they read as standing around or queuing up to be killed. In the 7.0s frame a treant still seems to be standing under the column. At this resolution I can't confirm whether the front treants run at a full sprint at about 6 steps per second. I'm not sure, so I'm marking it fail.

video.gaze.evidence: [影魔·codex] 图1中我的头部较小，眼睛与眼神方向无法可靠辨认。第2–4行（2.00–7.75秒）只能看出大致朝画面右方，不能确认每发出手前锁定对应目标、举手时仍盯落点，以及出手后转看下一组；第5行（8.00–9.75秒）也无法辨清规格要求的由近到远扫视尸堆。没有充分证据确认逐拍视线正确，按拿不准即fail判定。；[树人·claude] Image 1. In every frame from 0–6.75s the treants are tiny, about 10–20 px high in the sheet. I can't make out their faces or eye sockets. I can only see that their bodies face left toward him. So I can't confirm the spec's requirement that each treant that isn't hit keeps staring at him while it charges and never looks at the camera. In the 5.25–6.5s frames, a few treants in the right-hand groups look like they're turned toward the viewer or facing sideways, but I can't be sure. Because I can't verify this, I'm marking it fail. Fallen treants (from 7.5s on) aren't counted for gaze.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] As a first-time viewer I can tell part of the story but not all of it. What reads clearly: a red, lava-bodied giant stands on the left the whole time (0.000–11.750), and a horde of small creatures is charging across the plain (0.000–1.250). What doesn't read: (1) Who cast the skill. A black smoke column appears in the middle of the horde at 1.500, and more columns follow (3.250, 5.000, 6.250, 7.000). Nothing connects them to the giant: no projectile, beam, glow from its hand, or wind-up and release. From 2.000 on the giant stretches out an arm, but the gesture doesn't line up with when the columns appear. The columns are also black smoke or tornado-like, which doesn't match the giant's fire and lava look, so I can't tell the giant made them. (2) What the skill is. In 4.000–4.750 and 8.000–8.750 the columns turn into a gray haze and look like dust clouds or smoke, not a flashy spell. (3) The result is too small to read. From about 7.500 the creatures are gone, and from 9.000–11.750 the ground is covered in pale white shapes. At this size I can't tell whether these are skeletons, corpses or debris, so I can't confirm the enemies were wiped out. Overall, the caster, the spell and the outcome can't be explained with confidence, so this fails.
